name: skill-governance
description: Inventory, govern, audit, and improve skills across local and imported environments.

interface.shortDescription: Govern every skill with one auditable policy.
interface.longDescription: Discovers skills, applies skill-level enablement policy, records observable loads and invocations, diagnoses failures, and proposes safe user-skill improvements.
defaultPrompt: Show every known skill and its status.
Which skills overlap or failed recently?
Audit skill usage and suggest improvements.
